title: Orchard crate pickup
brief:
You run a neighborhood produce shop that returns empty wooden crates to a small orchard. Write a text message to the orchard’s delivery coordinator. The shop has 18 folded crates ready, six more than usual. Friday’s delivery is scheduled for 8:30 a.m., and the usual loading spot will be occupied by a window cleaner until 9 a.m. Offer to meet the driver at the side entrance at the usual time, and ask whether there is room for all 18 crates.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

1c78b2c9f6e6e6d8.text: Hi! We’ve got 18 empty wooden crates folded and ready to go back to the orchard with Friday’s delivery. That’s six more than we usually send back. The window cleaner will be using our usual loading spot until 9 a.m., so I can meet the driver at the side entrance at 8:30 a.m. as planned and have the crates waiting there. Could you let the driver know about the side entrance and check whether there’ll be room on the truck for all 18?
